name: game-standalone-views
goal: Generated 2D and 3D games follow authored view transitions and restore per-view checkpoint progress.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The generated page binds document.views[0] permanently; transition actions change state.view but the UI never enters that view. The engine and authoring workspace already support enterView progress restoration.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The CLI matrix fetched SSR HTML only, and standalone image acceptance played one view. Extend those existing cases to run the browser against generated source and bundled CLI projects, enter a second view and return with the first checkpoint image restored.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Unchanged source and bundled 2D/3D browser cases fail at a81ac7026: checkpoint transitions must enter the target view. Inspected capture still shows The courtyard after collecting the key and requesting second view.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Use existing enterView to resolve checkpoint transition targets immediately, rerender the selected view and restore its own completed checkpoints.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: All five CLI cases pass at cb760ee2c: source and bundled CLI in both dimensions play a transition to Second chamber, return to The courtyard and restore the saved checkpoint image. Inspected matching transition screenshot shows Second chamber and a fully rendered scene.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
